_argVocab.A|B: either A or B depending on a runtime condition; "|false" / "|empty" = optional slot
_argVocab.XLink (improvementLink, terrainLink, uni: buildXLinkVariable -- linked, iconed name of entity X
_argVocab.bool: boolean TEXTVAR feeding a {true_n:...} conditional slot; "(...)" notes its meaning; "bool(false)" = constant false
_argVocab.cooldown: cooldown type mapped to stun/immobilize text
_argVocab.effectCitySourceLink: buildEffectCitySourceLinkVariable -- human name of what grants an effectCity (religion/improvement/law/etc.)
_argVocab.list(X): comma/AND/OR list of X items (TextBuilder scope)
_argVocab.raw: a TEXT_* key stored in the field itself, rendered verbatim
_argVocab.statName/victoryName/missionResultName/o: plain TEXT of the referenced info
_argVocab.turnScale: buildTurnScaleName -- "year"/"turn" word, scaled by game speed
_argVocab.value: plain integer TEXTVAR; "(abs)"/"(prob)"/"(final)"/"(turns)" qualify what the number is
_argVocab.yieldIconLink(TRAINING): buildYieldIconLinkVariable for a fixed yield (icon only)
_argVocab.yieldValueIconLink: buildYieldValueIconLinkVariable -- yield icon + signed value link; ":rate" suffix = bRate:true, ":percent" suffix = bPercent:true; "(CIVICS)"/"(TRAINING)" = fixed yield

crossReferenceRenders: effectCity: "Can build <units>" -- unit.xml entries whose prereq references the effectCity (TEXT_HELPTEXT_CAN_BUILD_UNITS)
effectCity: "Disabled improvements" -- improvementClass.xml maeEffectCityDisabled reverse lookup (TEXT_HELPTEXT_EFFECT_CITY_HELP_DISABLED_IMPROVEMENTS)
effectCity: "Unlocked by" -- other effectCity.EffectCityUnlock reverse lookup (TEXT_HELPTEXT_UNLOCKED_BY)
effectCity: per-source yield counts -- other effectCity aaiEffectCityYieldRate/Modifier indexed by this effectCity (TEXT_HELPTEXT_EFFECT_CITY_HELP_YIELDS_EFFECT_CITY_YIELD_COUNT)

effectPlayer: "Unlocks <tech/project/improvement>" -- tech.xml/project.xml meEffectPlayerPrereq, project meCapitalEffectPlayerPrereq, improvement meEffectPlayerPrereq reverse lookups (TEXT_HELPTEXT_EFFECT_PLAYER_HELP_UNLOCKS_EFFECT / _UNLOCKS_PROJECT / _UNLOCKS_PROJECT_CAPITAL / TEXT_HELPTEXT_TECH_UNLOCKS_IMPROVEMENT)
effectPlayer: "Disabled laws" -- law.xml maeEffectPlayerDisabled reverse lookup (TEXT_HELPTEXT_EFFECT_PLAYER_HELP_DISABLED_LAWS)
effectUnit: vegetation attack penalty -- vegetation.xml maiDefendEffectUnit indexed by this effectUnit (TEXT_HELPTEXT_EFFECT_UNIT_HELP_ATTACK_INTO with negated value)
effectUnit: "Units" list -- units carrying the effect (TEXT_HELPTEXT_EFFECTUNIT_UNITS)
_meta.keyNaming: registry keys are the C# InfoEffect*/InfoBonus member names (m-prefixed); xmlField is the tag the game actually reads from the Infos XML
sourceFiles: reference/Source/Base/Game/GameCore/InfoBase.cs (member -> XML tag mapping via infos.read*() calls)
_meta.templateMarkup: templates kept verbatim from <en-US>, including {N_type} arg slots, {true_N:...}/{false} conditionals, <true_N>...<false>...<end> branch markup and |pipe| grammar alternates; CDATA wrappers stripped

unmappedFields.field: meMemoryAllFamilies / meMemory / mbTeamAlliance / mbTribeAlliance / mbTribeInvade / meAddLeaderRelationship / miDivorcedBySubject / mlpAddRelationship*
unmappedFields.reason: rendered, but the exact TEXT key sits in code regions outside the audited grep windows or is composed from runtime context; textKey left null or set to the dominant variant -- see notes on each entry
condensed event-option renderers reusing the same fields with abbreviated keys; not separately enumerated
occur in bonus.xml but are rendered by trade/tribute mission helpers, not by buildBonusHelp itself
not rendered in buildBonusHelp main path (achievement/goal/occurrence/AI/scenario plumbing or render handled elsewhere)
drive buildEffectCitySourceLinkVariable (attribution label), not effect lines; intentionally not registry entries
validity/eligibility plumbing or rendered only as modifiers inside other lines (e.g. unit-trait validity selects the {1} slot of NEW_UNITS_WITH; iClassNum renders as roman numeral in the class link)
